hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r uv run ruff format --quiet
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r uv run ruff check --quiet --no-fix
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r -I{} uv run mypy {} --no-error-summary 2>/dev/null || true
echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -q '\.env$' && echo 'BLOCK: Cannot access .env files containing secrets. Use .env.example instead.' && exit 1 || true
